"""Run the actual current T.2 CPU dry-run commands and exercise without weight updates."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import os
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/workspace/tiny-perceptron-vlm')
source = 'course/training.md'
sha = lambda raw: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
now = lambda: datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
def section():
    raw = (root / source).read_bytes()
    hs = list(re.finditer(rb'(?m)^## ([A-Z\d]+\.\d+) [^\r\n]+', raw))
    i = next(i for i,h in enumerate(hs) if h[1] == b'T.2')
    return raw[hs[i].start():hs[i+1].start() if i+1<len(hs) else len(raw)]
started = now()
body = section()
fences = re.findall(r'```bash\n(.*?)\n```', body.decode(), re.S)
assert len(fences) == 1
lines = fences[0].splitlines()
assert lines == [f'python scripts/train.py --task {task} --device cpu' for task in ['text','sft','vision']]
cases = [('original_'+task, line, task) for line,task in zip(lines,['text','sft','vision'])]
cases += [('exercise_text',lines[0],'text'),('exercise_sft',lines[0].replace('--task text','--task sft'),'sft')]
env = {**os.environ, 'OMP_NUM_THREADS':'1', 'MKL_NUM_THREADS':'1'}
records = []
for case, line, task in cases:
    argv = line.split()
    assert '--train' not in argv and argv[-2:] == ['--device','cpu']
    program = ('import runpy, sys, torch\n'
               'def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):\n'
               '    raise AssertionError("Dry-run unexpectedly updated or saved weights")\n'
               'torch.optim.AdamW.step = forbidden\n'
               'torch.save = forbidden\n'
               f'sys.argv = {argv[1:]!r}\n'
               'runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0], run_name="__main__")\n')
    command = [str(root/'.venv/bin/python'), '-c', program]
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    objects = [json.loads(s) for s in result.stdout.splitlines() if s.strip()]
    assert len(objects) == 2
    first, report = objects
    assert report['mode'] == 'dry-run-no-weight-update' and report['task'] == task and report['device'] == 'cpu'
    assert report['history'] == [first] and first['step'] == 1
    assert math.isfinite(first['loss']) and math.isfinite(first['grad_norm']) and first['grad_norm'] > 0
    if task in {'text','sft'}:
        expected = {'text':(111,5.7530,1.0268), 'sft':(8,5.4658,2.7651)}[task]
        assert first['effective_tokens'] == expected[0]
        assert abs(first['loss']-expected[1]) < 0.0001
        assert abs(first['grad_norm']-expected[2]) < 0.0001
    if task == 'vision':
        assert first['effective_tokens'] is None
        assert abs(first['loss']-5.9620) < 0.0001
        assert abs(first['grad_norm']-1.8985) < 0.0001
    records.append({'case':case,'guide_command':line,'program':program,'program_sha256':sha(program.encode()),'command':command,'exit_code':result.returncode,'stdout':result.stdout,'stderr':result.stderr,'verified_step':first})
assert section() == body, 'T.2 source changed during the actual checks'
version = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(root/'.venv/bin/python'),'-c','import json, platform, torch; print(json.dumps({"python":platform.python_version(),"platform":platform.platform(),"torch":torch.__version__}))'],cwd=root,text=True))
receipt = {'schema_version':1,'started_at':started,'checked_at':now(),'status':'passed','lesson_id':'T.2','source':source+'#T.2','source_sha256':sha(body),'previous_receipt':{'path':'docs/validation-artifacts/history/technical-revision-T.2-guide-code-6305145d2d03bca6ef02ba2c70aadb13bde46bc3e8f26abebbe7f1df8de017ec.json','sha256':'6305145d2d03bca6ef02ba2c70aadb13bde46bc3e8f26abebbe7f1df8de017ec','scope':'Preserved actual five-command check of the previous 373e54 T.2 body; not a check of the current new vision/null text.'},'scope':'Actual original text/SFT/vision CPU dry-run commands and the text-to-SFT exercise in separate Python processes. AdamW.step and torch.save guards confirm these paths did not call an update or weight save. No generated notebook exists for this guide. This receipt does not measure per-image forward-call counts, perform formal training, or claim GPU, installation, remote Colab, or whole-book offline validation. Forward-call counts are independently covered by the original factual reviewer.','command':'.venv/bin/python /tmp/verify-corrected-guide-t2.py','environment':{**version,'omp_num_threads':'1','mkl_num_threads':'1'},'result':{'total':len(records),'passed':len(records),'failed':0},'repository_sources':{'scripts/train.py':sha((root/'scripts/train.py').read_bytes())},'records':records,'verification_program':Path(__file__).read_text()}
path = root/'docs/validation-artifacts/technical-revision-T.2-guide-code.json'
path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
